answer_1.quote: We answer the questions by first validating the set of atomic assumptions and then generating an interpretable answer A by verbalizing L_AA.
answer_1.outputs: Interpretable answers pinpointing false/true atomic assumptions

answer_3.quote: We generate a set of atomic assumptions AA from Q and then validate each AA_i ∈ AA to obtain L_AA using GPT-4o with a few-shot chain-of-thought prompt.

answer_4.quote: The generated interpretation is evaluated manually by checking whether it pinpoints the false assumptions... We analyze 50 FP and 50 FN errors from each benchmark (300 total).
answer_4.guideline: Manual annotation of atomic assumption interpretations
